infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrackMe requires location access to search for your current position and draw routes to your destination.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TrackMe needs access to your location in the background to continuously update your live trip route and calculate correct remaining ETAs even when the device is locked.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: TrackMe needs continuous background location tracking to monitor your safe arrival and stream movement telemetry.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow TrackMe to use your location at all times to calculate live distance and ETAs while on the move.
